observations: Control panel with buttons, a small LCD screen, and a central dial.
Brand 'YAMAHA' is visible on the top left of the control panel in photo 0.
Watermark 'PRIME AUDIO POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.
The keyboard is shown in a domestic or shop environment with other keyboards in the background.

claims.evidence: The brand 'YAMAHA' is visible in photo 0, but the model name 'DGX 200' is not legible on the front panel.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included. Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not power on or produce sound.
risks.proof: A video of the keyboard being powered on and playing a scale or demo song.

risks.risk: Individual keys or buttons may be unresponsive or 'dead'.
risks.proof: A video of a chromatic scale being played across all keys.

risks.risk: The LCD screen may be cracked or have dead pixels.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the screen while the unit is powered on.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be dead or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the keyboard running on battery power alone.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a constant power source

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the keyboard powered on and playing a full chromatic scale to test all keys.
Video of the LCD screen displaying a menu or test tone while the unit is on.
Photo of the rear ports and the power adapter.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
